verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a voice-agent framework with documented telephony support (Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Exotel, SIP), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions sending DTMF keypresses, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. Generic telephony transport and Flows node transitions are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
